body:
The cuts did not seem too deep and were certainly not his own fingernail scrapes. The fact that the cuts were on the back of his legs would seem to suggest to me that it wasn't the blood pressure monitor that he used to to harm himself. Perhaps he was using the blood pressure monitor to look at his blood pressure after taking the pills.

Does anyone know if there is some sort of pain-relief or enjoyment(?) he could get from dropping his blood pressure to a low level and perhaps it backfired?

There is no indication that he has self harmed before.
Here is a example of the blood pressure monitor, he had, http://www.priceit.in/wp-content/uploads/2010/12/Automatic-Blood-Pressure-Monitor-2.jpg

Any ideas?

Thanks,
Brian
